item.title: How Silicon Valley Is Turning Scientists into Exploited Gig Workers
item.description:
📝 (Eva Marie Uzcategui / Getty) Silicon Valley would not exist without government-funded research. As graduate students at Stanford, Larry Paige and Sergey Brin relied on funding from the National Science Foundation to develop the search algorithms that would eventually become Google. Over 10,000 federal workers with STEM PhDs left the federal workforce last year.
🔗 Read more: https://www.thenation.com/article/society/ai-silicon-valley-andreesen-thiel-stem/
